learning_objectives: Identify a socket-location fault without condemning known-good processors or memory.
matches.public_setup_summary: Known-good processors work in other pairings, but configurations that depend on one CPU socket do not boot.

learning_objectives: Use cross-bay known-good comparisons to isolate a shared distribution fault.
matches.public_setup_summary: The server reports a voltage error and shuts down immediately even after component reduction and supply/bay comparison.

learning_objectives: Treat predictive failure as actionable while protecting data and proving completed recovery.
matches.public_setup_summary: A drive reports predictive health warnings and a mixed amber/green bay indication while the array remains available.

learning_objectives: Separate read-only evidence preservation from the state-changing Repair that clears a stale alert.
matches.public_setup_summary: Healthy drive and backplane evidence conflicts with a persistent degraded management alert.

learning_objectives: Use repeated version A/B behavior and hardware elimination to diagnose a firmware regression.
matches.public_setup_summary: Network link flaps began after a management firmware change even though swapped hardware and cabling remain healthy.

learning_objectives: Bound dangerous controller recovery to approved platform methods and verify recovery separately from the flash action.
matches.public_setup_summary: A failed controller firmware update leaves the management controller unavailable while the board requires a bounded recovery decision.
